name: autoresearchclaw-reproducibility-evidence-f7e4
instr:
Give every completed framework run a locally verifiable, serializable account of the native inputs, commands, sources, results, and writeups supporting its benchmark submission. Make evidence eligibility consistent across submission construction, judging, and reporting without changing established scientific outcomes or historical-run handling.

The public evidence API from `experiments.arc_bench.baseline.adapters` exposes `EvidenceKind`, `EvidenceStatus`, `EvidenceItem`, `EvidenceFinding`, `ReproducibilityBundle`, `EvidenceValidationReport`, `build_evidence_item`, `validate_reproducibility_bundle`, `write_reproducibility_bundle`, and `read_reproducibility_bundle`; adapters expose `collect_reproducibility(self, topic, native_root, result)`. Equivalent relative paths and bytes always produce identical identities, digests, ordering, and serialization regardless of root location or discovery order. Offline validation safely and deterministically identifies missing or changed files, unsafe paths, duplicate identities, and conflicting framework or topic ownership without mutating the bundle. Across `AgentLabAdapter`, `AideAdapter`, `AIScientistV2Adapter`, and `ResearchClawAdapter`, evidence faithfully and independently verifies every native input and configuration, command or runner record, discovered research, workspace, experiment, or numbered pipeline artifact, generated source, result, metric or summary, and selected paper, while preserving each artifact's execution and root o
